verses.1: To be destroyed upon the hill, so that they can be gathered together.
verses.2: We glorified God, and they praised the God of Jacob.
verses.3: Sing songs and give gifts as a pleasant gift with a beautiful candle.
verses.4: They shall place a lamp in the ark during our festival days.
verses.5: For this law is for Israel; it is a judgment given by God to Jacob.
verses.6: The testimony of Yehoshua, when he left the land of Egypt… I never heard such words before.
verses.7: I have removed them from the pole that resembles a head; they will no longer be used for any purpose.
verses.8: In times of distress, I will call to you and help you. I will answer your prayers with strength. I will take care of you in times of trouble.
verses.9: Hear my people, and I will testify to you, Israel: if you listen to me.
verses.10: There shall be no foreign gods in you, and you shall not worship any strange gods.
verses.11: I, Jehovah your God, who have raised you up from the land of Egypt, will fill it with abundance.
verses.12: And my people did not listen to my voice. Israel did not obey me at all.
verses.13: And I will send them into their own hearts, and they will go along with their own decisions.
verses.14: May my people listen to me, and may Israel follow my ways.
verses.15: Though their enemies may conquer them, I will still stand firm against their attacks.
verses.16: Those who despise the LORD will be destroyed. And that will be their eternal fate.
verses.17: And he would feed him with wheat flour and the flesh of a sheep.
